hypotheses: The actual separated mixed objects have an index-independent upper complex weight W.
Their restrictions to every parameter fibre have an index-independent upper ordinary degree E.
The separation comparisons and all subsequent maps exist in the mixed category with the asserted normalizations.

source_obligations.label: deform:colimit
source_obligations.literal: Suppose that each calculation and all transition maps are linear in a single input $M_q(r)$. Assume their substitutions by $\mathcal L_n(r)$ lift to mixed diagrams compatibly with \eqref{eq:logarithm-sequence}.

source_obligations.label: planch:weight-estimate
source_obligations.literal: Fix a test chart, a stalk $\xi$, and a degree $j$. The mixed Hodge structures $H^j((\widehat K_\beta)_{\xi,q=1})$ have a common upper weight bound, independent of $\beta$ and hence of all pole, configuration, label, and skeletal indices.

jacobian.scope: One exact generic rank calculation; not a proof of geometric hypotheses or an all-index colimit theorem.
